Visit note | 2025-06-15 04:30 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Bushra Akter, 79, female. Mrs. Akter comes for review reporting tightness in her chest when walking fast or climbing, alongside breathlessness on effort, and mentions experiencing jaw and left arm discomfort on effort with no chest pain. Her symptoms started while carrying shopping bags uphill in Tejgaon. She works as a farmer, lives with her family, and has no recorded comorbidities. On examination: BP 150/96 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 59 kg. Chest is clear and heart sounds are normal. Assessment: Stable angina. Plan: a prescription was issued today. She was advised to avoid heavy exertion until review, walk 20 minutes daily on flat ground, and stop smoking. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and fasting lipid profile.
